name: Create a namespace
description: Create a namespace Creates an empty Artifacts namespace for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces
Creates an empty Artifacts namespace for an account.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; body (body)

name: Delete a namespace
description: Delete a namespace Deletes an empty Artifacts namespace. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}

name: Get a namespace
description: Get a namespace Returns an Artifacts namespace summary. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}

name: List namespaces
description: List namespaces Lists Artifacts namespaces for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces
Lists Artifacts namespaces for an account.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.
Optional: limit (query); cursor (query)

name: List repository tokens
description: List repository tokens Lists tokens for a repository. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/tokens
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/tokens
Lists tokens for a repository.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; name (path) — Repository name.
Optional: state (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Read a Git blob
description: Read a Git blob Returns raw bytes for an immutable Git blob object. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/blob/{hash}

name: Read a Git commit
description: Read a Git commit Returns decoded metadata for an immutable Git commit object. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/commit/{hash}

name: Create a repository
description: Create a repository Creates a Git-compatible Artifacts repository in a namespace. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos
Creates a Git-compatible Artifacts repository in a namespace.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; body (body)

name: Delete a repository
description: Delete a repository Deletes a repository and schedules cleanup of its backing data. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}

name: Read a file
description: Read a file Returns raw bytes for a file resolved by ref and path. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/file
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/file
Returns raw bytes for a file resolved by ref and path.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; name (path) — Repository name.; ref (query) — Git ref, branch, tag, or commit hash.; path (query) — File path.

name: Fork a repository
description: Fork a repository Forks a source repository into a new repository. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/fork
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/fork
Forks a source repository into a new repository.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; name (path) — Repository name.; body (body)

name: Get a repository
description: Get a repository Returns repository metadata. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}

name: Import a repository
description: Import a repository Imports an HTTPS Git repository into an Artifacts repository. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/import
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/import
Imports an HTTPS Git repository into an Artifacts repository.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; name (path) — Repository name.; body (body)

name: List repositories
description: List repositories Lists repositories in a namespace. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos
Lists repositories in a namespace.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.
Optional: limit (query); cursor (query); search (query); sort (query); direction (query)

name: Read commit history
description: Read commit history Returns commit metadata walking backwards from a ref, branch, tag, or HEAD. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/log
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/log
Returns commit metadata walking backwards from a ref, branch, tag, or HEAD.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; name (path) — Repository name.
Optional: ref (query) — Git ref, branch, tag, or commit hash. Defaults to HEAD.; limit (query); offset (query)

name: Read a raw file with content type
description: Read a raw file with content type Returns file bytes resolved by ref and path, with a sniffed content type and browser-safe response headers. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/raw/{ref}/{path}

name: Read a Git tree
description: Read a Git tree Returns decoded entries for an immutable Git tree object. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/repos/{name}/tree/{hash}

name: Create a repository token
description: Create a repository token Creates a scoped Git token for a repository. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/tokens
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/tokens
Creates a scoped Git token for a repository.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; namespace (path) — Artifacts namespace name.; body (body)

name: Revoke a token
description: Revoke a token Revokes an Artifacts repository token. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/artifacts/namespaces/{namespace}/tokens/{id}
